implementation.identity_scope: Compiled source and lockfile fingerprint plus the executing file digest. Repository revision and dirty status are runtime observations of the compile-time source directory, not a claim that those current Git bytes produced this executable.

scope.collector: one host collector with separate per-object reception roles
scope.time: caller-driven logical slots; channels are host opportunities
